items.definition:
gladly received
You are always welcome in our home.

not dirty
Please keep your room clean.

German
She is learning the German language.

feeling unwell; ill
She felt sick after eating too much candy.

having a lot of flesh
The cat was very fat.

moving or operating at a low speed
The internet connection is very slow today.

feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy
She felt sad when her pet left.

in good health
Eating fruits and vegetables helps you stay healthy.

occupied, active
I'm too busy to talk right now.

free from moisture or liquid
The clothes are dry now.

moderately hot
The tea is still warm.

a primary color
The sun is yellow.

feeling or showing anger
She was very angry about the delay.

orange
She wore an orange dress.

not clean
Your hands are very dirty.

covered or saturated with water or another liquid
Don't sit on the wet grass.

producing or capable of producing much noise
The music was very loud.

a pale red color
Her favorite color is pink.

of great height
He is a very tall man.

a color between black and white
The sky was gray and cloudy.

feeling or showing the need for food
I'm so hungry, I could eat a horse!

a color intermediate between blue and red
Her favorite color is purple.

less
I have less time today than yesterday.

sunny
It's a beautiful sunny day.

not happy
She was unhappy with the results.

feeling a need to drink
I'm so thirsty, I need a glass of water.

needing sleep; tired
The baby was very sleepy after a long day of playing.
